ms.title: Akmal mahu jadi wira? Tanggunglah akibatnya
ms.excerpt: Dalam isu bendera terbalik, Ketua Pemuda UMNO Akmal terus memprovokasi dan memberi “tempoh dua hari” kepada pihak berkuasa. DAPSY Bukit Bendera membuat laporan polis dan menuntut siasatan, termasuk dakwaan menyeru perhimpunan haram.
ms.body:
Ketua Pemuda UMNO, Akmal Saleh, dalam isu “Jalur Gemilang terbalik” telah berulang kali mencetuskan provokasi, ugutan, malah memberi “ultimatum dua hari”, seolah-olah mahu mengugut pihak berkuasa.

**Ini bukan sahaja satu bentuk politik samseng, malah ancaman serius terhadap keamanan negara!**

DAPSY Bukit Bendera telah membuat laporan polis secara rasmi, menuntut siasatan penuh terhadap kenyataan serta tindakan Akmal, termasuk dakwaan penganjuran perhimpunan haram.

Jika Akmal mahu berlagak jadi “wira”, dia mesti bersedia menanggung akibat undang-undang!

en.title: Akmal wants to play hero? Then he must face the consequences
en.excerpt: In the upside-down flag row, UMNO Youth chief Akmal kept provoking and gave the authorities a “two-day deadline”. DAPSY Bukit Bendera lodged a police report and called for an investigation, including into alleged calls for an illegal rally.
en.body:
UMNO Youth Chief Akmal Saleh, in the “upside-down Jalur Gemilang” saga, has kept provoking and threatening, and even issued a so-called “two-day ultimatum”, trying to intimidate the authorities.

**This is nothing less than political bullying, and a direct threat to national peace and harmony!**

DAPSY Bukit Bendera has officially lodged a police report, demanding a full investigation into Akmal’s statements and actions, including his alleged role in organising an illegal assembly.

If Akmal wants to act like a “hero”, then he must be ready to face the consequences of the law!

zh.title: 阿克马想当民族英雄？必须付出代价
zh.excerpt: 在“倒挂国旗”事件中，巫青团长阿克马不断挑衅，还给执法单位设“两天限期”。升旗山社青团已向警方报案，要求彻查，包括他涉嫌号召非法集会。
zh.body:
巫青团长阿克马在“倒挂国旗”事件中，不断挑衅、威胁，甚至设下所谓“两天限期”，企图以恐吓方式干预执法单位。

**这不仅是赤裸裸的政治霸凌，更是对国家安宁的威胁！**

升旗山社青团已正式向警方报案，要求彻查阿克马的言行，包括他涉嫌号召非法集会。

阿克马若要逞“无谓英雄”，那就必须承担法律后果！

相关新闻：中国报、光明日报（搜：升旗山 林智成）。
